title: Timeline layer folders: add-folder button, indent/collapse, drag into folder
description: The core model already has full folder layer support (LayerType='folder', parentFolderId, collapsed flag on Layer, layer-folder.ts helpers, setLayerType). The SWF compiler ignores folder layers correctly. But the Timeline UI is completely missing the folder affordances: (1) no 'Add Folder Layer' button in the bottom-left toolbar (Flash 8 has a dedicated folder icon next to +/−); (2) folder layers show an 'F' badge but child layers are not indented — parentFolderId is never read in Timeline.tsx; (3) the collapse arrow on a folder row does nothing (collapsed field on Layer is set via layer-folder.ts setFolderCollapsed, but Timeline never calls it nor reads it); (4) there is no drag-into-folder gesture. Scope: add an 'add folder' button that calls addLayer then setLayerType(...,'folder'); render child layers indented under their parentFolderId parent; wire the collapse arrow to toggle collapsed and hide/show child rows; (optionally) allow drag-and-drop to reassign parentFolderId. Acceptance: author can create a folder layer, drag normal layers into it, collapse/expand it to hide/show children, and delete it.
